content.comment_body: Is there a way to expand the memory capacity of the counter instruction? Right now the preset tops out at 999999 decimal. Can this be increased to handle bigger values?

Hello! Increasing the maximum value directly isn't possible, but you can connect multiple counters in sequence. I've attached an example—try using simulation mode to test it out. In my test, the first counter was set to 5 and the second to 10. Keep in mind, summing all values gets tricky since math functions may not handle very large numbers—consider switching to [product_name] for larger scales.
Check the attached example program. This setup allows counting from 1 up to 999,999,999,999.

analysis.insight_summary: Users wish to surpass the counter memory limit in [company_name] logic controllers, currently set at a maximum of 999,999. The community confirms this preset cannot be increased directly, but suggests linking multiple counters or using other control platforms as alternatives. A limitation is noted regarding mathematical functions, which may not process aggregated values from multiple counters if numbers grow too large.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for the counter instruction to support higher preset values—preferably above 999,999—or want the memory limit to be configurable so larger counts can be accommodated.
